status: declared by the pull request that closes #966 before any score was computed; a measurement, not a record. Nothing is published: no arm joins any published declaration, no day after 2025-12-31 is scored, no rule changes, and the live record and pin do not move. The flag and its quoted replication (+1.3% CRPS pooled, +2.6% in 2024-26 on B1's change pool) come from Lens B of the five-lens review (#958) after the author had seen 2018-2025, so a result here is exploration, never a verdict (scoring protocol v1, #640). Whether any arm joins #634's candidates is Eleonora's
hypothesis: H5 (primary goal): the SOFR - IORB spread distribution in bp. Step 3 (2021-23 and the residual pools), development tier
ruling: Eleonora, 19 October 2026 (relayed on #958), directive #966. Different from #948, which is the floor as a target transform. Abstaining on flagged days is not an arm: more than 5% missing forecasts voids a registration (docs/decisions/scoring-protocol.md:257)
target: spread_bps at the scored day, in basis points, as a 23-quantile distribution at each lead h = 1..5 (scoring_protocol.GRID)

flag.name: floor flag
flag.spread_to_floor: SOFR less the ON RRP offering rate in force on that row, in bp, with SOFR from the panel row
flag.rate_in_force: the offering_rate_percent of the latest on_rrp entry of metadata/policy_events.json that was announced at or before that row's decision instant (the row's date at the decision time, 16:00 ET) and is effective on or before the row's date, ordered by effective date then announcement; an entry that carries no offering rate (a limit-only change) does not set the rate; a retroactive entry, announced after the instant, is not read (policy_events.known_entries). This queue does not ingest the rate series (#643)
flag.rule: on when the median of the spreads to the floor of the last 60 rows at or before the row is at most 1 bp (rounded to nine places), with at least 40 of those rows defined; off when above; undefined (no flag) when fewer than 40 are defined
flag.as_of: row i reads rows i-59 to i and no later row. floor_flag.check_no_future rebuilds the flag from the panel cut at the row and raises LookAheadError on any difference, the pattern of satiation.check_no_future; the scoring script runs it on every anchor row it reads, before any forecast
flag.expected_on_windows: from 2021-04-21 to 2023-12-11 and from 2024-02-14 to 2024-07-09 (Lens B's reading of the same rule); the run reports the windows it finds and the difference, if any

flag_b1.label: (i) B1's change pool restricted to the anchor's flag state
flag_b1.structure: B1's quantiles: the anchor's spread plus the empirical quantiles of the trailing two years' h-row changes; a change joins the pool when the flag at its origin row (s - h) equals the flag at the anchor
flag_b1.minimum: a lead whose restricted pool holds fewer than 60 changes, and an anchor with no flag, use B1's full pool

flag_mr.label: (ii) the mean-reversion candidate's eps_h pool restricted to the anchor's flag state
flag_mr.structure: repo_model.spread_mean_reversion (#686), unchanged except for the residual pool: level + phi^k * (last - level) + eps_h, with eps_h the empirical quantiles of lead h's training residuals whose origin row has the anchor's flag; phi, level, k, the training window, the 60-pair minimum and the refit every 21 decision days are #686's
flag_mr.minimum: a lead whose restricted pool holds fewer than 60 residuals, and an anchor with no flag, use the whole-lead pool (spread_mr_level10's)

flag_gbm.label: (iii) gbm_funding wrapped in the two-part rule
flag_gbm.structure: flag on at the anchor: B1's law; flag off or undefined: gbm_funding's law. gbm_funding is the phase 2 gbm at 23 levels of #634 (the best pooled primary score there); its missing forecasts are filled by B1 as the protocol does (scoring_protocol.fill_missing)
flag_gbm.walks: arm (iii) needs gbm_funding's walks at the five leads, which take hours and are not run in the cloud (#46: a step over about two hours goes to Eleonora's Mac); the script reads them from a directory, and the (iii) section of the result arrives as a commit on the pull request's branch

references.spread_mr_level10: the reference row of arm (ii): #686, unchanged. 'Its own pool' in the kill rule is this row
references.benchmarks: B1 and B2 of scoring protocol v1 (repo_model.protocol_benchmarks)

scoring.scorer: repo_model.scoring_protocol (#655), the development tier: no verdict, no registration
scoring.days: decision days with a forecast of every series, mean reversion and the arms included, whose five targets (h = 1..5 business days later on the panel's calendar) fall on or before 2025-12-31; no day after 2025-12-31 is read and the scored days pass lockbox.require_unlocked (docs/decisions/lockbox.md). Section (iii) is on the days gbm_funding's walks cover
scoring.primary: grid CRPS (23 levels), the mean over leads 1..5 per decision day, paired against B1 and B2; arm (ii) also against spread_mr_level10 and arm (iii) also against gbm_funding: skill = mean(d) / mean(S(benchmark)) with d = S(benchmark) - S(candidate), positive favours the candidate
scoring.key_secondary: upper-tail twCRPS with weight 1{z > 0 bp} (scoring_protocol.upper_tail_twcrps), the same pairs
scoring.interval: scoring_protocol.paired_tests: the studentized stationary bootstrap (ruling 1, #739): mean block 10 business days, 10,000 draws, seed 966. A two-sided 90% interval is skill less the 95th and 5th percentile of the skill's studentized draws times its HAC standard error. A comparison the studentization cannot resolve is reported as undefined, with the means
scoring.outcomes: the panel's spread_bps at the target day, not the first-published vintage of protocol section 11

splits.lead: h = 1, 2, 3, 4, 5: the decision days' score at that lead alone
splits.pressure_day_type: the target day's reporting day type (quarter-end, month-end, tax date, ordinary)
splits.flag_state: the flag at the decision day's anchor: on, off, undefined
splits.minimum: a group with fewer than 20 days is listed and not tested

kill.rule_ii: arm (ii) shows no gain over its own pool (spread_mr_level10): its grid CRPS skill against spread_mr_level10 on the target days of 2024-26 has an interval that covers 0 or lies below it
kill.rule_iii: arm (iii) loses to gbm_funding pooled by more than its interval: its grid CRPS skill against gbm_funding on all walk days has an upper interval bound below 0
kill.reading: a kill is a statement about development days; it neither supports nor kills the hypothesis H5 and registers nothing

variants: three arms on one flag, no new fit beyond #686's own refits
limits: no published declaration changes; nothing after 2025-12-31 and no lockbox day is scored; the flag and the pools read the panel and metadata/policy_events.json only
